name: GA4 form_submit tracking - HubSpot embedded forms (permanent)
desc: Fires GA4 form_submit for the Contact Us and Inno+ inquiry forms, and job_application for the HR form. HubSpot's new embed renders inside a cross-origin iframe, so GA4 Enhanced Measurement cannot see the form; this listens for HubSpot's cross-frame callback. Origin-checked. Emits only through window.gtag, which snippet #7 defines only after CookieYes analytics consent.
